description_en: Initiates a quota usage report query. This API applies only to general quotas
description_zh: 发起配额使用率报告查询，本api只对通用配额生效
name: StartQuotaUtilizationReport

ErrorMsg.example: You are not authorized to do this action or the API input parameter is invalid.

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result, such as report generation has started or the allowed refresh time has not been reached. Use RefreshSuccess to determine the submission result instead of relying on the prompt text for programmatic judgment
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果的说明，例如已开始生成报告或尚未到允许刷新时间。建议使用 RefreshSuccess 判断提交结果，不依赖提示文本进行程序判断
Message.example: Quota utilization report generation has started

NextRefreshTime.description_en: The UTC time when the next refresh can be initiated. The format is yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z', such as 2026-10-26T08:00:00Z. This parameter is returned when the task is not submitted due to refresh limits, and is empty when the task is successfully submitted
NextRefreshTime.description_zh: 下次允许发起刷新的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'，例如 2026-10-26T08:00:00Z。因刷新限制未提交任务时返回；成功提交任务时为空

RefreshSuccess.description_en: Indicates whether the report generation task was successfully submitted. A value of true indicates that the asynchronous task was submitted, but the report is not yet generated. A value of false indicates that the refresh limit period has not ended and no new task was submitted
RefreshSuccess.description_zh: 是否成功提交报告生成任务。true 表示异步任务已提交，不代表报告已生成；false 表示仍处于刷新限制期，本次未提交新任务

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
